sources.title: IBM i 7.5 — Working with object ownership
IBM i Security reference — object ownership (SC41-5302 appendix)

asciiPanel:
Work with Objects by Owner

User profile . . . . . . . . . . :   PAYADMIN

Type options, press Enter.
  2=Edit authority        4=Delete   5=Display authority
  8=Display description   9=Change owner
                                                             ASP
Opt  Object        Library       Type      Attribute         Device
     PAYMST        PAYROLL       *FILE     PF                *SYSBAS

Parameters or command
===>
F3=Exit   F4=Prompt   F5=Refresh   F9=Retrieve
F18=Bottom
notes: Option 2 routes to EDTOBJAUT; option 9 runs CHGOBJOWN from command line. Subfile paging uses F7/F8; F18=Bottom per IBM work-with-object panels.
auditNotes: Ownership chain analysis — option 9 CHGOBJOWN, option 2 EDTOBJAUT. QMGTOOLS SCTMNU RTVOBJLST complements WRKOBJOWN for support-driven ownership reports.
qmgtoolsRelation: GO MG → 22 → 7 (SCTMNU) → RTVOBJLST for owned-object list export.
